texts.name: Bandit Trouble
texts.description: Listen here, stalker. Some punks in track suits have been robbing rookies on the way to my bunker. Bad for business. Go and teach them some manners - permanently.
texts.success: Well, well. The road's quieter already. Here's your cut.
texts.fail: Couldn't handle a few thugs? Maybe the Zone isn't for you.

texts.name: Thinning the Herd
texts.description: Bandits are like rats: kill one and three more crawl out. Still, every one you put down is one less knife in a rookie's back. Get to it.
texts.success: Good work. The rookies will sleep better tonight. So will I.
texts.fail: The bandits are laughing at both of us now.

texts.name: Debt Collection
texts.description: One of the bandit gangs owes me for a crate of vodka they "forgot" to pay for. I don't care which ones you shoot - the message will get through.
texts.success: Message received, I'd say. Pleasure doing business.
texts.fail: No message, no money. Simple as that.

texts.name: Hired Guns
texts.description: Mercenaries. Good gear, no loyalty, and they're cutting into my artifact trade. Somebody with deep pockets wants them gone, and that somebody pays through me.
texts.success: Professional work. My client is pleased, and so am I.
texts.fail: The mercs are still out there. My client is not happy.

texts.name: Competition
texts.description: Foreign operators have been sweeping the area and taking what's mine. I want them to understand this territory has an owner.
texts.success: Now they understand. Here, you earned it.

texts.name: Military Sweep
texts.description: The military are running a sweep and shooting anyone who isn't wearing their patch. Hit them where they're holed up. Carefully - these aren't bandits.
texts.success: The sweep's been called off. Funny how that works.
texts.fail: The soldiers are still out there. Keep your head down.

texts.name: Checkpoint Breaker
texts.description: A squad of spetsnaz has set up shop and is choking my supply routes. Make them reconsider their posting.
texts.success: Supply routes are open again. Good.
texts.fail: No supplies, no stock. You're not helping either of us.

texts.name: Renegades
texts.description: A group of deserters has dug in with heavy weapons and decided they're a faction now. Remind them what happens to people who forget who runs this area.
texts.success: Renegades, mercenaries - all the same once they're dead. Good job.
texts.fail: They're still dug in. Maybe bring a bigger gun next time.

texts.name: Children of the Monolith
texts.description: Robed fanatics are coming out at night, chanting about a stone that grants wishes. Whatever they are, they kill stalkers. Find them in the dark and end their prayers.
texts.success: So they do bleed. Here. And don't tell anyone what you saw.
texts.fail: The chanting hasn't stopped. I can hear it some nights from the bunker...

texts.name: Faith and Bullets
texts.description: The Monolith zealots took a scout of mine. I don't expect him back. I do expect payback.
texts.success: That's for my scout. Take this, you've earned it.
texts.fail: Nothing? Then my scout died for nothing.

texts.name: Zone Samples
texts.description: A scientist friend of mine is paying top roubles for fresh samples. Anomalies throw artifacts into stashes and caches all over the place - go dig some up. Found in the Zone, mind you; I can tell when you've bought it off some flea-market crook.
texts.success: Fine specimens. The egghead will be thrilled.
texts.fail: No samples, no money. The scientist will find another supplier.

texts.name: A Special Order
texts.description: I've got a buyer from the Big Land who wants a very particular set of artifacts. Bring them to me untouched - straight out of the Zone.
texts.success: That's exactly what the client wanted. Here's your share.
texts.fail: The client walked. That's money out of both our pockets.

texts.name: After the Blowout
texts.description: The last emission stirred up the anomalies something fierce. Fresh artifacts will be turning up in caches and corpses. Bring me what I need before the vultures get it.
texts.success: You beat the vultures to it. Good stalker.
texts.fail: The vultures got there first. Shame.
